usedFor: Slide holds contacts, and Zoom signs people up when “When a new contact is created” runs “Register Attendee for Webinar”.

bestTemplate.name: “When a new contact is created” in Slide, then “Register Attendee for Webinar” in Zoom
bestTemplate.why: A new contact is registered for your webinar without anyone adding them.

watchOut: “When a contact is updated” fires on every edit, so the same person could be registered twice.
